rules.colour: White on dark backgrounds, black on light. One colour for every icon in a set; the accent colour only to highlight one item.
rules.use: Icons support a label, never replace it. Use them on feature, KPI and story slides; never as decoration. Keep every icon in a row the same size.
rules.has_text: Icons with lettering in the artwork need at least 0.5 in.
rules.duplicate_of: Same artwork as another icon; prefer the one named.
